;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Syrian Civil War]], [[Northwestern Syria offensive (April 2019–present)#Army captures rebel pocket, surrounds Turkish observation post|2019 Northwestern Syria offensive]]
**The [[Syrian Army]] captures the entire northern [[Hama Governorate|Hama]]-southern [[Idlib Governorate|Idlib]] rebel pocket, asserting control over the strategic towns of [[Kafr Zita]], [[Al-Lataminah]] and [[Murak, Syria|Murak]], as well as numerous villages and [[Tell Afis|an archaeological site]], following the withdrawal of rebel forces. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-syria-security-northwest/syrian-army-captures-hama-rebel-pocket-in-northwest-state-media-idUSKCN1VD0P1 (Reuters)] [https://www.almasdarnews.com/article/breaking-syrian-army-captures-entire-northern-hama-pocket/ (''Al Masdar News'')]
**The [[Turkish military operation in Idlib Governorate|Turkish observation post]] near Murak is [[encirclement|encircled]] by government forces. [https://aawsat.com/english/home/article/1869021/syrian-regime-forces-surround-turkish-army-post (Asharq Al-Awsat)] [http://www.ansamed.info/ansamed/en/news/sections/generalnews/2019/08/23/syrian-govt-forces-advance-south-of-idlib_93fb60b4-4fb7-44c8-99be-bb94e06a3223.html (Ansamed)]
*[[Iran–Israel proxy conflict]]
**[[United States|U.S.]] officials confirm that an airstrike on an [[Iran]]ian weapons depot in [[Amirli]], [[Iraq]] on July 19 that killed two Iranian military commanders was conducted by [[Israel]]. The strike is the first known Israeli attack inside Iraq since [[Operation Opera]] in 1981. [https://www.voanews.com/middle-east/us-officials-confirm-israeli-strike-iraq (Voice of America)]
*[[Al-Qaeda]] accuses "treacherous Pakistani forces" of detaining the wife and two other relatives of the group's leader [[Ayman al Zawahiri]] for over a year. [https://english.alarabiya.net/en/News/world/2019/08/23/Al-Qaeda-claims-Pakistan-detained-wife-of-its-chief-Zawahiri.html (Al Arabiya)]
;Disasters and accidents
*[[2019 Brazil wildfires]]
**[[Finland]], current chair of the [[European Union]], asks the bloc to contemplate a ban on beef from [[Brazil]] in response to the ongoing disaster. [https://uk.reuters.com/article/us-brazil-politics-eu-beef/finland-urges-eu-to-consider-banning-brazilian-beef-over-amazon-fires-idUKKCN1VD17R (Reuters)]
;International relations
*[[China–United States trade war]]
**China retaliates on the United States' latest tariff decisions by imposing tariffs of up to 25% on some American goods. [https://www.cnbc.com/amp/2019/08/23/china-to-retaliate-with-new-tariffs-on-another-75-billion-worth-of-us-goods.html (CNBC)]
**[[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]] states on Twitter that he has "hereby ordered" that U.S. companies find an alternative for manufacturing in China and relocate "HOME." [https://www.barrons.com/amp/articles/tech-stocks-plunge-on-trump-order-to-pull-back-from-china-51566582247 (''Barron's'')] [https://www.theguardian.com/technology/2019/aug/23/trump-hereby-order-response-president-mocked-decree (''The Guardian'')]
**President Trump announces an increase in the tariffs set to take effect on September 1, October 1 and December 15, from 10% and 25% to 15% and 30%, respectively. The [[Office of the United States Trade Representative]] says it will "begin the process of increasing the tariff rate to 30% effective October 1 following a notice and comment period". [https://www.cnn.com/2019/08/23/politics/donald-trump-china-tariffs/index.html (CNN)]

;Politics and elections
*[[2020 Democratic Party presidential primaries]]
**[[United States House of Representatives|U.S. Representative]] for [[Massachusetts]] [[Seth Moulton]] announces his suspension of his 2020 presidential campaign. [https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/2020-election/seth-moulton-ends-presidential-campaign-n1045536 (NBC News)]
*[[President of Uruguay|Uruguayan President]] [[Tabaré Vázquez]] is diagnosed with a [[malignant tumor]]. [https://www.losandes.com.ar/article/view?slug=confirman-que-tabare-vazquez-presidente-de-uruguay-tiene-un-tumor-maligno (''Los Andes'')]
*[[Sri Lanka]] ends its [[state of emergency]], four months after the [[2019 Sri Lanka Easter bombings|Easter bombings]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/08/sri-lanka-ends-emergency-rule-imposed-easter-bombings-190823134350525.html (Al Jazeera)]
